name: Dreamsap Pools
introDiscord:
Golden dreamsap gathers in pools beneath the roots, its surface
flickering with fragments of sleeping thoughts. Dreamsap Leeches drift
beneath those visions, feeding on whatever the forest dreams.
introTwitch:
Golden dreamsap gathers in pools beneath the roots, its surface
flickering with fragments of sleeping thoughts. Dreamsap Leeches drift
beneath those visions, feeding on whatever the forest dreams.

dreamsap-pools-approach.prompt:
Three routes curve around glowing pools. Each surface reflects a dream
that belongs to someone else.

left.message:
Broad silver kelp wraps a Star Candy cache beside a pool showing a
traveler dancing beneath a sky full of moons.

The dream continues after you leave.

right.message:
A pleasant dream ripples across one pool.

A shadow crosses beneath it.

A Dreamsap Leech bursts through the memory.

forward.message:
Fresh dreamsap collects inside a folded leaf.

Shizuki's note reads:

'Fresh sap = healing.

Old sap = weird dreams.

CHECK LABEL.

I did not check label.'
forward.fullHpMessage:
You leave the fresh dreamsap untouched. You're already healthy and
there is no reason to accidentally sample the nightmare vintage.

dreamsap-pools-depths.prompt:
Moonlit fronds shade deeper pools where the dreams become clearer and
stranger.

left.message:
A Dreamsap Leech swims beneath a vision of someone running.

The dreamer looks behind them.

The Leech appears exactly where they were looking.

right.message:
A shrine coffer rests beneath a root surrounded by softly glowing
dreamsap. Inside are Star Candies and one tiny glass vial labeled:

'DO NOT DRINK OLD SAP.'

Useful.

forward.message:
One Berry rests beside Shizuki's dream journal.

'Dreamed Glimmer became enormous and carried me across forest.

Glimmer woke up smug.

Suspicious.'

dreamsap-pools-threshold.prompt:
Three rootways descend toward Sleeping Rootwell. The sap here is darker,
and its dreams no longer look peaceful.

left.message:
A fresh moonblossom pool sits safely above the old dreamsap.

Shizuki's note:

'THIS one is medicine.

I underlined it.

Growth.'
left.fullHpMessage: You leave the clearly identified restorative untouched.

right.message:
A dark dream spreads across the pool.

Something moves inside it.

A Dreamsap Leech pushes through the reflection.

forward.message:
An offering basket contains Star Candies above the blackened sap.
Someone very wisely placed it on a tall root.

boss-antechamber.name: Sleeping Rootwell
boss-antechamber.prompt:
Every dreamsap pool goes dark.

One enormous nightmare begins spreading through them all.

bossPromptDiscord:
The visions across Sleeping Rootwell merge into the same dream.

A huge shadow moves beneath every pool simultaneously.

The smaller Leeches flee into the roots as the nightmare grows closer
to the surface.

Use /yes to approach the Rootwell or /no to wake from this part of the
forest later.
bossPromptTwitch:
The visions across Sleeping Rootwell merge into the same dream.

A huge shadow moves beneath every pool simultaneously.

The smaller Leeches flee into the roots as the nightmare grows closer
to the surface.

Use !yes to approach the Rootwell or !no to wake from this part of the
forest later.
bossRetreatText:
You back away from Sleeping Rootwell. The dark dream remains trapped in
the pools behind you.

boss.revealText:
The black dreamsap erupts as a colossal Leech rises through the shared
nightmare.

Nightmare Sapmother reveals itself!

completionText:
"The Nightmare Sapmother sinks into the deepest rootwell.

The dreams return.

One briefly shows an enormous Glimmer carrying Shizuki through the
forest.

Suspicious indeed."
